messages:
marta: Heads-up: need quick copy check for the Console logs empty state when project retention = 7 days. Tone: helpful, not threatening. Thoughts?

jamal: Short + clear. Users should immediately know what's currently available and what action to take.

riley: Legal/ops flagged wording that implies permanent deletion. Avoid 'deleted' or 'lost'. Also keep CTA neutral (e.g., 'Choose a plan').

ux-bot: Accessibility note: avoid lone-verb CTAs. Prefer 'Compare plans' or 'See plan options'. Also ensure the ARIA label for the button describes destination.

marta: Drafts below. Please pick one or mix.

Draft 1:
```
Only the last 7 days of logs are visible in the Console.
Choose a plan to store logs for longer and view extended trace history.
[See plan options]
```

Draft 2 (softer):
```
Logs older than 7 days aren’t kept in the Console by default.
Select a plan to keep logs beyond 7 days and access longer traces for debugging.
[Compare plans]
```

Draft 3 (question-led):
```
Need older logs?
Pick a plan to increase retention and unlock historical traces.
[Change retention]
```

eli: Prefer Draft 2. "Kept in the Console by default" is non-threatening and accurate. CTA 'Compare plans' is fine.

jamal: Can we add a single-line admin tooltip: "Retention is set per project and may differ by plan"? Helps avoid support tickets.

riley: Yes. Also ensure links go to retention matrix on pricing page. Ops needs the matrix.

marta: Final copy proposal:
```
Logs older than 7 days aren’t kept in the Console by default.
Select a plan to keep logs past 7 days and access longer trace history for debugging.
[Compare plans]

Admin tooltip: Retention is configured per project and may vary by plan.
```

ux-bot: Accessibility checklist: button text = 'Compare plans'; ensure focus order, provide aria-describedby linking to tooltip text.

eli: I'll QA in staging with NVDA. If all good, we can push to Figma and the component library.

marta: Thanks — will update the component and tag design QA. Closing unless any objections.
